changelog: - I593: The enemy fleet upgrade you've been waiting for is in the game. The four oldest enemy ships - the swarm drone (now a sharper boomerang), the missile-dart stinger, the armored turret ship warden (now a solid hexagonal fortress with three mounted armor slabs), and the crescent flyer - are all their rebuilt versions, with more surface detail and a brighter finish. The new ships are smaller files than the old ones, so the download shrank by 241,108 bytes (now 6,851,950 bytes). Waves, scoring, and controls are unchanged.
